The presentations follow the documents in a didactic sequence, from the framework and the sources to the energy accounts, the emissions accounts and their dissemination. Their charts and numbers are read from the same tables as the documents.

| Presentation | Covers |
|:--------------------|:----------------------------------------------|
| [Energy and emissions accounts: framework and sources](01-framework-and-sources.qmd) | Why energy and emissions statistics need accounts; The SEEA: energy flows, supply and use tables, territory and residence; The energy balance, the supply and use tables and the inventory |
| [The IMF tools and a reproducible pipeline](02-tools-and-pipeline.qmd) | What the PEFA Converter and I2A take in and give back; Why the same logic was rewritten as an open pipeline; Two layers that must agree, checks at every step, and how to run it |
| [Energy accounts: classifications and allocation](03-energy-classifications-allocation.qmd) | Products, flows and activities of the energy accounts; How each line of the balance finds its industry, and the two keys; The concordance matrix and what the converter does with it |
| [Energy accounts: residence, checks and results](04-energy-residence-results.qmd) | Territory, residence and the bridge to the balance; Identities, agreement with the tool and plausibility; First results: who uses energy, and energy intensity |
| [Air emissions accounts: sources and classifications](05-emissions-sources-classifications.qmd) | Accounts and inventory: gases, scope and files; From emitting processes to emitting units; The rule table and the keys shared with the energy accounts |
| [Air emissions accounts: allocation, residence and results](06-emissions-allocation-results.qmd) | The conversion matrix and where Tunisia departs from the default; Residence adjustment with OECD data and the bridge table; Implied emission factors, first results and dissemination |
| [Indicators, dissemination and the way forward](07-indicators-way-forward.qmd) | Users, core indicators and dissemination formats; Energy and emissions together, and the place of households; An annual production cycle, roles and priorities |
